subject: Value creation meets AI — quick thought for Revelstoke's PTG
body: Andrew, Your move from McKinsey's PE procurement practice to leading Strategic Partnerships & Value Creation at Revelstoke caught my eye. The Portfolio Transformation Group is doing something most healthcare PE firms talk about but few actually build — a dedicated ops team that drives real post-acquisition value. We built Gumbo to plug directly into that kind of structure. Our AI agents handle the operational heavy lifting across portfolio companies — think due diligence automation, back-office integration, and cross-portfolio intelligence — so your PTG team can focus on strategy instead of spreadsheets. With 200+ acquisitions and a growing portfolio, I imagine the integration complexity only compounds. Would love to show you how Gumbo could accelerate what your team is already doing well. Open to a 15-minute call this week? Best, Jim
